# el-portal-hero design system

> The component set and tokens for el-portal-hero. Every UI change imports from `@/components/ui`; nothing here is published to npm, so this file is the machine-readable index.

Import: `import { Button } from "@/components/ui"` (or `@/components/ui/button` for one file).
Tokens: `src/app/globals.css` - CSS custom properties. Use the token or a Tailwind utility bound to it; never a raw hex, rgb() or an arbitrary `[#...]` value.

## Components

- [accordion](src/components/ui/accordion.tsx): Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger
- [animated-group](src/components/ui/animated-group.tsx): AnimatedGroup
- [badge](src/components/ui/badge.tsx): Badge, badgeVariants
- [button](src/components/ui/button.tsx): Button, buttonVariants
- [card](src/components/ui/card.tsx): Card, CardAction, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle
- [container-scroll-animation](src/components/ui/container-scroll-animation.tsx): Card, ContainerScroll, Header
- [scroll-area](src/components/ui/scroll-area.tsx): ScrollArea, ScrollBar
- [separator](src/components/ui/separator.tsx): Separator
- [shiny-button](src/components/ui/shiny-button.tsx): ShinyButton

## Vocabulary

Names models reach for that this system does not have, and what it calls them instead
(counts are how often the wrong name was invented across the benchmark's mined sample):

- prop `as` -> use `asChild` (170 inventions)
- prop `color` -> use `variant` (49 inventions)
- prop `severity` -> use `variant` (9 inventions)

## Notes

- Generated from src/components/ui by forge/scripts/design/ds_readiness.py. Re-run it after adding a component.
